Hi Alice 

Thanks again for taking time earlier today to walk through FinTechCorp's security intake and the production questions your team needs to close the procurement checklist. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary of the call:
- Discussed Redwood's security posture, SOC 2 status, and incident response processes.
- You requested evidence around incident notification timelines, BCP/DR controls (RTO/RPO), and a filled vendor security questionnaire.
- Confirmed potential HIPAA scope for certain FinTechCorp workloads  you requested our standard approach and whether we sign a BAA.

Action items we committed to: 
1) Share our most recent SOC 2 Type II summary and redacted report for initial review (we can provide full report under NDA).
2) Provide incident response (IR) runbook excerpts showing detection -> assessment -> customer notification timelines and escalation paths.
3) Complete and return your vendor security questionnaire template.
4) Set up a technical deep-dive with our security/infra lead to cover encryption, key management, and DR specifics (RTO/RPO).
5) If HIPAA applies, route the BAA request to our legal/security team and share the DocuSign link.

Can you confirm the preferred email for receiving the questionnaire back (procurement@fintechcorp.com ok?), and any deadline you have for the questionnaire and SOC2 evidence? We can aim to get the initial bundle to you by EOD tomorrow (Thu 7/1) pending approvals.

Thanks  Ill loop in Jordan for the SOC2 and IR artifacts.
